title: Coordination of Benefits Between Primary and Secondary Coverage — Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility
content:
**Policy.** Under Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility, claim lines adjudicate on the primary record first, and the patient responsibility the primary leaves is posted as charges on the primary account. When a secondary record exists, the secondary pays on those charges as set out below.

## 1. What the secondary pays

1.1 On the deductible charge, the secondary pays only when its class pays the primary's deductible portion as secondary (the register of secondary behaviour by payer class records which classes do).

1.2 On the coinsurance charge, the secondary pays its class's percentage of the primary's coinsurance portion of that charge, rounded to the cent half up. *Partly retired:* for a Medicaid secondary's crossover on a coinsurance charge from an oxygen line, and only for such a crossover, this clause is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis; every other secondary payment on a coinsurance charge remains under this clause as written.

1.3 The secondary pays nothing on copay, non-covered-with-notice, upgrade-difference, self-pay, repair patient share or unreturned-equipment charges.

## 2. How a secondary payment is posted

2.1 A secondary payment is posted on the primary account against the charge it settles, carrying the secondary record as the paying coverage, and it never exceeds the open amount of that charge. *Partly retired:* for a Medicaid crossover on a coinsurance charge from an oxygen line that the current crossover basis prices, and only for such a crossover, this clause is no longer in force; every other secondary payment remains under it and never exceeds the open amount of the charge it settles.

2.2 When the primary class crosses claims over automatically, the secondary payment follows crossover without a separate claim. Otherwise the secondary claim must be filed within the secondary class's secondary-claim filing period after the primary adjudication, and a secondary payment refused for late filing leaves the charge with the patient.

2.3 The paying secondary coverage record is in status active or terminated. This is read from the system's record of the paying secondary coverage before the payment is posted.

## 3. Order of payment

3.1 Medicaid Fee-for-Service is always the payer of last resort: when it is held together with any other coverage it is secondary.

3.2 A coverage priority correction is made only after a coordination update request on the record is approved. The approval is read from the request attached to that coverage record.

## Points of judgement

| Situation | Result under this policy |
|---|---|
| Secondary class does not pay the deductible portion; a deductible charge sits on the primary account | the secondary pays nothing on the deductible charge |
| A copay charge sits on the primary account | the secondary pays nothing on it |
| The paying secondary record is pending verification | the record is not in status active or terminated, so it is not a paying secondary record |
| The primary does not cross over automatically and the secondary claim was filed after the secondary class's filing period | a secondary payment refused for late filing leaves the charge with the patient |
| A patient holds Medicaid Fee-for-Service and Commercial PPO | Medicaid Fee-for-Service is the secondary |
